Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Get edit configuration tree root

items.docs: Returns the root resource of the edit configuration tree. This provides links to all configurable resources in the domain.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Start an edit session

items.docs: Starts a new configuration edit session. Only one edit session can be active per user. The edit session locks the domain configuration for exclusive modification by the current user.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Activate pending changes

items.docs: Activates all pending configuration changes made during the current edit session. This distributes changes to all affected servers in the domain.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Cancel the current edit session

items.docs: Cancels the current edit session and discards all pending configuration changes.

info.name: Oracle WebLogic Server APIs Undo unactivated changes

items.docs: Reverts all unactivated changes within the current edit session without ending the session.
